einzeiler: Daniel Lanois looks back at his legendary career working with Bob Dylan, U2 and Neil…
kurzfassung: Producer and musician Daniel Lanois reflects on his storied career shaping iconic albums for legendary artists. He discusses the creative processes behind groundbreaking records with Bob Dylan, U2, Peter Gabriel, and Neil Young. Additionally, Lanois shares insights into his latest instrumental project, Belladonna Nocturne.
stichpunkte: Daniel Lanois views instrumental music as a universal language designed to transport listeners to specific locations.
He explains his signature production technique of self-sampling and reintroducing processed tones into multi-track recordings.
Collaborating with D'Angelo on Red Dead Redemption involved building an entirely new track around a single recorded line.
Lanois mixed a cover of a Bob Dylan song with the Neville Brothers on a cassette machine and never bettered the mix.
Working on U2's Achtung Baby in Berlin involved a team of strong creative personalities focused entirely on originality and soul.
He details how he manipulated an electric grand piano to create cascading rainfall harmonics on Peter Gabriel's Red Rain.
Lanois describes using a blackboard with written chords to guide U2 through complex arrangements during Joshua Tree sessions.
He stresses the importance of emotional resonance and soul over mere sonic perfection when producing records.

clips.hook: A masterclass in crafting piano textures and splicing tape
clips.text: The guest describes altering piano hammers with extra felt to reduce fundamental frequencies, drawing a parallel toGlenn Gould's editing methods.

clips.hook: Prioritizing the listening room over stadium stages
clips.text: A record producer explains why he focuses on moving listeners at home rather than tailoring music exclusively for massive stadium concerts.

clips.hook: Turning an electric grand piano into a rainstorm
clips.text: The guest details how repeatedly bouncing audio effects through processing units transformed a keyboard part into an otherworldly mesh of harmonics resembling distant monks.

clips.hook: Managing alpha personalities in a Berlin studio
clips.text: The discussion turns to assembling a team of strong-willed creators in Germany to chase originality and soul while delegating monitor mixes to a dedicated floor engineer.

clips.hook: Emotional phase cancellation through timeless melodies
clips.text: The musician explains his concept of emotional phase cancellation, where a deeply resonant song absorbs and neutralizes a listener's personal sadness.

beschreibung:
With his new album, Belladonna Nocturne, out now, legendary producer Daniel Lanois looks back at his entire career. He reflects on his work with Bob Dylan, U2, Neil Young, Peter Gabriel, D'Angelo, and more in an in-depth interview with host Brian Hiatt.
